prompt: Locked camera, framing unchanged. From the first frame the little terrier, standing with its front paws on the old man's knee, wags its tail quickly from side to side, mouth closed. The groundskeeper scratches the top of its head with slow fingers while still looking up at the trees with a small, contented smile, his cup held in his other hand. Above, the wind streams through the tall trees, leaves rippling and branches swaying. The wheelbarrow and flask stay still. Overcast daylight, real footage, warm and calm.
